android_boot_splash.description: Android userspace boot animation; the installer replaces this file instead of writing the raw MTK logo region.

notes: Boot region: only the 6 MiB boot region at offset 0x1D80000 is ever written for root ADB; read back and SHA-256 verified before reboot.
Android boot splash: /system/media/bootanimation.zip is backed up, replaced, and pulled back for SHA-256 verification.
The raw MTK logo region at offset 0x2A40000 is intentionally never written by the installer.
Preloader, lk/uboot, nvram, secro, protect_* and the whole flash are never written.

Before removal, each present package APK is copied to the SD backup path and host run directory; app data is copied when SELinux permits, otherwise pm uninstall -k retains it in place. Removal is refused if the APK backup marker cannot be created.
com.xugame.gameconsole is the retained emulator and must never be removed or disabled.
The stock controller map /system/usr/keylayout/mtk-kpd.kl is preserved byte-for-byte; no ES input map is cleared or regenerated.
No 'pm clear' and no user data (ROMs, saves, states, input maps) is touched.
